title: Telling Stories

expressions.example: Meanwhile, her brother had already left.
In the end, everything worked out fine.
Once upon a time, there was a small village.

sentences: Meanwhile, her brother had already left the house.
In the end, everything worked out fine.
After she had finished dinner, she went for a walk.
Before I arrived, they had already started the meeting.
When he opened the door, he had forgotten his keys inside.
Once she had told the story, everyone laughed.
Eventually, they found the missing dog.

grammar.title: Narrating the Past — Past Perfect + Sequencers
rules: Past perfect (had + V3) mostra uma ação que aconteceu antes de outra no passado: They had left when I arrived.
"Before/after/when" conectam a ordem dos eventos na narrativa.
"Suddenly/meanwhile/in the end" organizam a história cronologicamente.
Combine past perfect com past simple para mostrar sequência de eventos.

rows: ação anterior a outra no passado
They had left when I arrived.
After she had finished, she left.
In the end, everything worked out.
